theorems.statement: ((∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1), Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ (IsCompact X.support → IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ {y : Euclid (N + 1) | ∃ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))}) ∧ ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → Continuous (fun t => X (η t)) ∧ Y ω = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (η t)
